---- Applicant
 Versus
  State of Chhattisgarh Through : Police Station Dabhra,
 District Janjgir-Champa (C.G.).
 ---- Respondent
For Applicant : Mr. Ravindra Sharma, Advocate For Respondent : Mr. Aman Kesharwani, P.L.
Hon'ble Smt Justice Rajani Dubey Order on Board 21/02/2023
1.

The applicant has preferred this second bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail as he is custody in connection with Crime No.356/2021,
registered at Police Station - Dabhara, District Janjgir-Champa (C.G.) for the ofence punishable under Sections 302, 376, 201 of IPC.
2.
Earlier bail application of the applicant was dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to revive the same after examination of material witnesses.
3. After arguing at length, learned counsel for the applicant seeks permission of this Court to withdraw the bail application.
He, however, prays for direction to the trial Court to conclude the trial as early as possible.
5. Accordingly, the bail application is dismissed as withdrawn.
6. The trial Court to conclude the trial as early as possible, preferably within a period of four months from the date of receipt of copy of this order.
